layout_observed: Spa-Francorchamps 7.004km F1 loop; station zero is before Bus Stop, not start/finish.
lighting_weather_observed: Dry bright race; earlier qualifying/pit shots cloudy or wet.
review_scope: 16 sparse overview frames viewed by author. Clip is an edited career/race montage, includes menus/cuts and changing conditions; not a continuous lap. Unviewed timestamps are not evidence.

reviewed_visual_evidence.notes: Bus Stop and Grand Prix pits: Broad slow chicane, red/yellow kerbs and local paved escape. Grand Prix garage/hospitality bar on right of race direction, covered stands opposite, white event roofs and green banks.

Bus Stop and Grand Prix pits: Broad slow chicane, red/yellow kerbs and local paved escape. Grand Prix garage/hospitality bar on right of race direction, covered stands opposite, white event roofs and green banks.
La Source and old pit descent: Hairpin opens to dramatic valley descent. Modern grandstand and old endurance pit structures; close red/yellow kerbs, paved outside escape. Do not flatten the descent.

Eau Rouge and Raidillon: Iconic compression and steep uphill left-right-left. White/dark-timber gabled historic chalet at foot; large modern angular Raidillon covered stand, wooded slopes and gravel outside.
Kemmel, Les Combes and Malmedy: Long uphill forest-lined straight with narrow grass and Armco. Open spectator slopes and brown gravel/soil outside braking/chicane area; dense mixed conifers beyond.

Bruxelles, Speakers Corner and Pouhon: Descending wooded corners with broad red/yellow kerbs, outside grass/gravel and constrained advertised walls. Tree-covered banks enclose lower valley, not a flat plain.

Fagnes, Campus and Paul Frère: Forest sequence with corner-specific gravel traps, green/red painted margins and small white track facilities. Protection follows runoff edge, never continuous blocks across paved escape.
Blanchimont return: Fast rising forest corridor, red/yellow edge kerbs, narrow grass verges and metal Armco/catch fencing; broad spectator hillside at return toward Bus Stop.
